messages:
Noah Patel: Opening a 45m change window for infra: terraform apply to add VPC peering + IAM role bindings tied to release candidate RC-2026-03. Need module + provider pins and a short rollback ladder.

Lena Dubois: Paste pins please. I'll update release notes and the rollback playbook.

Noah Patel: Module pin and tfvars snippet:
```
module "vpc_peer" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood-infra/modules.git//networking/vpc_peering?ref=rc/2026-03-21-7a9b"
}

// terraform.tfvars.json
{
  "peer_vpc_id": "vpc-0abc123def",
  "iam_cross_account_role": "arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/redwood-crossattach"
}
```

Noah Patel: Provider pin: `required_providers { aws = { version = "~> 5.0" } }`

Deploybot: Preflight: terraform plan scheduled to run in 3m. If plan reports deletes on shared route tables, run will pause.

Lena Dubois: Rollback ladder (short):
1) Halt further applies.
2) Revert module ref to `release/2026-03-10-stable` and run `terraform apply -var-file=revert.tfvars.json`.
3) If connectivity degraded, fail traffic to backup TGW per runbook.

Noah Patel: We'll stagger applies by AZ and run a smoke curl to payment health endpoint after each AZ.

ops-bot: @channel Create release tracker entry and attach plan output.

Deploybot: Preflight result: plan OK, no deletions. Canary job queued as jt-11001 in 8m.

Noah Patel: Assigning Lena to monitor. I'll run the prod apply if canary is clean.

(After canary)
Lena Dubois: Canary apply succeeded. smoke tests pass. logs: https://ci.internal/reports/jt-11001

Noah Patel: Scheduling prod apply in 15m. Locking tfvars and tagging infra commit to rc/2026-03-21-7a9b.

Deploybot: Prod apply started (jt-11002). Streaming logs.

(7m later)
Deploybot: Prod apply finished: success. run_id=jt-11002.

Lena Dubois: Updated release notes with module commit, provider pin, run ids, and rollback steps. QA to sign off before announce.

Noah Patel: Thanks all. Closing window in 30m and marking infra commit pinned. :lock:
